note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation in this sermon was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS New Testament wording and the 1962-register Old Testament renderings the first translation carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, verses joined, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'; a verbatim recitation without quote marks counts (founder rule, 2026-11-19). `self_rendered` rows each carry a `why`: allusions woven into the preacher's sentences, the alternative versions of the text he cites, his deliberate misquotation of Ephesians 3:20, and Matthew 11:12 (decision 'violent-take-it-by-force').

Judgement calls: the text, Jeremiah 33:3, is OWB's «ወደ እኔ ጩኽ፤ እኔም እመልስልሃለሁ። የማታውቃቸውን ታላላቅና ከአቅምህ በላይ የሆኑ ነገሮችን አስታውቅሃለሁ።» identically at every recurrence; 'great and mighty things' is OWB's «ታላላቅና ከአቅምህ በላይ የሆኑ ነገሮች», and Spurgeon's argument (things beyond what we know or could reach) stands on it. 'Call upon Me in the day of trouble' (blocks 17, 29) is OWB Psalm 50:15 «መከራም ሲመጣ ወደ እኔ ጩኽ», which echoes the text's own «ወደ እኔ ጩኽ». 'Pray without ceasing' is 1 Thessalonians 5:17 «መጸለይን አታቋርጡ» and 'Continue in prayer' Colossians 4:2 «ሳታቋርጡ ጸልዩ» (decision 'pray-without-ceasing'). The 'mulberry trees' of 2 Samuel 5:24 are OWB's balsam trees («በበለሳን ዛፎቹ ጫፍ ላይ»), also in block 22's recitation. 'Wines on the lees well refined' is OWB Isaiah 25:6's «የተጣራ የቆየ የወይን ጠጅ». 'I wept much' (Revelation 5:4) is OWB «ምርር ብዬ ማልቀስ ጀመርኩ». Philippians 4:13 is OWB's «ብርታትን በሚሰጠኝ በእርሱ ለማንኛውም ሁኔታ ብርቱ ነኝ». In 2 Kings 4:7 Spurgeon dwells on the word 'and'; OWB has no free-standing 'and', so the preacher's aside now asks what came next. Job 42 is OWB 42:8 and 42:10 joined with '…', with 'And the Lord said' moved into the preacher's lead-in. Psalm 118:5 and 118:21 are joined with '…' as the English joins them. John 6:21's boat is OWB's ጀልባ, and the preceding sentence follows it.
